caption: The drawing features a central two-story house rendered in a pale peach or pink color, with symmetrical windows and a gabled roof, sitting in a landscape setting. To the left of the house, there is a large, light-colored rock formation or cliff, bordered by stylized dark green and brown foliage. Tall, dark green deciduous trees with thick canopies and prominent brown trunks fill much of the upper background on both sides of the house, and smaller bush-like plants in darker green occupy the lower foreground and background. In the right foreground, there is a human figure painted in light peach or pink, standing near the house, holding a fishing rod over a body of water that stretches horizontally across the front of the composition. The water is depicted with light peach and blue tones and bordered by a dark green strip of land. The sky fills the upper half of the image and is painted in a solid medium blue color. The entire composition is framed by a beige border.
title: Wallpaper for Bandbox Covering
